notes: Shopify store (Dawn-based theme) with Searchspring-powered collection grids (siteId qva9ht), same site/method as the prior Home-Decor pass (archive c42, see notes/39.md). Access: direct HTTP fetch, no blocking. robots.txt checked: no Claude/Anthropic-specific disallow, only generic Disallow: /search (so live site search was not queried, per robots.txt) and admin/cart/checkout paths. Navigation discovery: homepage header mega-menu has a full top-level 'Bestsellers' nav item with an enhanced megamenu exposing 'By Category' children (Art, Furniture, Decor & Pillows, Dining, Lighting, Pottery, Rugs) plus a 'View All' link to /collections/bestsellers; separately, the 'Gifts' top-level nav has its own 'Bestselling Gifts' child (/collections/gifts-by-category-bestsellers) under its 'By Category' section. Cross-checked against sitemap_collections_1.xml, which also lists bestsellers-bath and gifts-by-category-bestsellers -- bestsellers-bath is NOT linked anywhere in the live header/footer nav (orphaned Shopify collection, sitemap-only), so it was excluded as not a genuine current merchandising PLP. All qty values were captured from the Searchspring search API (https://qva9ht.a.searchspring.io/api/search/search.json?siteId=qva9ht&bgfilter.collection_handle=<handle> -> pagination.totalResults) and then independently cross-verified against Shopify's own /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 unique product-id count for every row below -- all 9 matched exactly (single-page fetch sufficient since every count is well under 250). The parent 'Bestsellers' (all) page total (106) does not equal the sum of the by-category children (13+35+19+5+14+4+17=107); this is expected -- the parent is an independently curated cross-category bestseller list, not a strict roll-up, and a product can appear in one child category but not make the parent cut or vice versa. 'Bestselling Gifts' (70) is listed separately since it lives under the Gifts nav item, not nested inside the Bestsellers megamenu, but it is a genuine site-labeled Bestsellers-type PLP (page heading/nav caption 'Bestselling Gifts', same Searchspring-grid template as every other collection) so it was recorded as its own row rather than folded into the main Bestsellers group. All pages confirmed to be real product-listing grids (ss-collection-snap.js Searchspring integration), not editorial/marketing pages, and no individual PDP was needed to resolve any ambiguity.
